Welcome to saber ! How may I help you?

To generate a radiology invoice, follow these steps: 
1. Choose consultation or service for billing from the service list. 
2. For radiology items, select the item code or name from the list and click on the 'Add' button. 
3. Select the payment category and allocate the cash/credit scheme to the patient. 
4. Click on the 'Estimate' button to view the estimated bill. 
5. Once ready to make the payment, click the 'Save' button. A pop-up will appear showing the payable amount details. 
6. Click 'Yes' to generate the invoice bill with a bill number. 
7. If needed, you can reprint the bill by clicking the 'Reprint' button. 

For more details, you can refer to the image provided: ![Related Image](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_113427.png)
